question: What protective refuge and radiant origin are attributed to the deity?
premises: The deity is a good refuge.
The deity arises from golden armor.
Obeisance is offered to these aspects.
inference: The deity is honored as a supreme refuge and as emerging from golden armor.
uncertainties: hiraṇya-kavaca-udbhava may refer to a specific mythic origin
plain_english: Obeisance to the good refuge; obeisance to the one born from golden armor.
